title: Laurus nobilis L. Essential Oil-Loaded PLGA as a Nanoformulation Candidate for Cancer Treatment.
authors: Ercin, Esin; Kecel-Gunduz, Serda; Gok, Bahar; Aydin, Tugba; Budama-Kilinc, Yasemin; Kartal, Murat
one_liner_zh: 该文研究月桂精油PLGA纳米制剂的抗癌活性，仅用UV-Vis滴定和分子对接简单涉及DNA结合与靶点预测，无TF-DNA互作体系、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: The aim of this study was to obtain essential oil (LNEO) from the Laurus nobilis L. plant, and to prepare LNEO-loaded poly lactic-co-glycolic acid (PLGA) nanoparticles (NPs) as an approach in cancer treatment. The components of the obtained LNEO were analyzed using GC-MS. The LNEO-NPs were synthesized by the single-emulsion method. The LNEO-NPs were characterized using UV-Vis spectrometry, Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS), Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), and a DNA binding assay, which was performed via the UV-Vis titration method. According to the results, the LNEO-NPs had a 211.4 +/- 4.031 nm average particle size, 0.068 +/- 0.016 PdI, and -7.87 +/- 1.15 mV zeta potential. The encapsulation efficiency and loading capacity were calculated as 59.25% and 25.65%, respectively, and the in vitro drug release study showed an LNEO release of 93.97 +/- 3.78% over the 72 h period. Moreover, the LNEO was intercalatively bound to CT-DNA. In addition, the mechanism of action of LNEO on a dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor was predicted, and its antiproliferative activity and mechanism were determined using molecular docking analysis. It was concluded that LNEO-loaded PLGA NPs may be used for cancer treatment as a novel phytotherapeutic agent-based controlled-release system.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在从月桂（Laurus nobilis L.）植物中提取精油（LNEO），并制备负载LNEO的聚乳酸-羟基乙酸共聚物（PLGA）纳米颗粒（NPs），作为癌症治疗的一种策略。采用GC-MS分析所得LNEO的成分。通过单乳液法合成LNEO-NPs。利用紫外-可见光谱法、动态光散射（DLS）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）及DNA结合实验（通过紫外-可见滴定法进行）对LNEO-NPs进行表征。结果表明，LNEO-NPs的平均粒径为211.4 ± 4.031 nm，多分散指数（PdI）为0.068 ± 0.016，Zeta电位为-7.87 ± 1.15 mV。包封率和载药量分别为59.25%和25.65%，体外药物释放研究显示，在72 h内LNEO释放率为93.97 ± 3.78%。此外，LNEO以嵌入方式与CT-DNA结合。同时，预测了LNEO对双重PI3K/mTOR抑制剂的作用机制，并通过分子对接分析确定了其抗增殖活性及机制。结论认为，负载LNEO的PLGA NPs可作为基于新型植物治疗剂的控释系统，用于癌症治疗。
